assumptions: Continuous numerical extension of the loaded Flight 12 V3 hardware estimate used for Flight 14 launch/deployment. The earliest deorbit command uses the observed early-deorbit window as a design input, not an exact flown ignition timestamp. Periapsis, alignment lead, safety limits and lift-up entry attitude are engineering estimates. No geographic landing target, dated Earth orientation, controlled terminal landing, booster return or water-contact outcome is reconstructed. The 90 km diagnostic endpoint is a descending physical-state gate; video values never overwrite state or drive target tracking forces.
